title: Image Data Type Conversion
text: Convert and scale input image to specified output data type, 1 input, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Output data type; {Signed}, {Word length} and {Fraction length}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | boolean | Fixed-point | Inherit via back propagation
